definitions.gloss: plain; easy; simple; easy to understand
definitions.explanation: Describes language, writing, or explanations that are clear and simple, avoiding difficult or technical expressions. Often used to praise clear writing or speaking.

examples.japanese: {平易|へいい}な{言葉|ことば}で{説明|せつめい}する。
この{本|ほん}は{平易|へいい}な{文章|ぶんしょう}で{書|か}かれている。
examples.english: This book is written in plain, easy-to-understand prose.

examples.japanese: {専門的|せんもんてき}な{内容|ないよう}を{平易|へいい}に{解説|かいせつ}するのは、{実|じつ}はとても{難|むずか}しい。
examples.english: Explaining technical content in plain terms is actually very difficult.

notes:
USAGE:
A na-adjective from {平|へい} (flat, even) + {易|い} (easy). Primarily used to describe language, text, or explanations — not physical tasks. Functions as a modifier with な ({平易|へいい}な{言葉|ことば}) or adverbially with に ({平易|へいい}に{書|か}く).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {平易|へいい}な{言葉|ことば} (plain language)
- {平易|へいい}な{文章|ぶんしょう} (plain writing)
- {平易|へいい}に{説明|せつめい}する (to explain in simple terms)
- {平易|へいい}に{書|か}く (to write in plain style)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {簡単|かんたん}: simple, easy — broader in use, not limited to language
- {分|わ}かりやすい: easy to understand — more colloquial
- {平明|へいめい}: clear and simple — a near synonym, slightly more literary
